lines: Review item 1, the white glass: the mend is complete in the code and passes its checks (types clean; 528 tests pass, 4 skipped). As a second net, the glass now turns a pixel that is no number into clear glass, never into a bright sheet. Publishing it is the next step.

The winter pixels of the last status are traced: 5 to 8 lone pixels move by one level when the test wraps a call whose base cannot be below zero by its own text; with the wrapper answering as the plain function the picture equals the plain one. The same size of step with three different answers (no number, 0, 1e30), so no picture rests on an open case there.
The strict check is now a command of the repo (npm run strict). It passes when no pixel moves by more than one level and at most 0.01 percent of pixels move.

Next, at once and in parallel: builders on the faults the fresh review named, shown below as the reviewer found them (the season change seen in one frame, the blank first frame, the phone framing, summer reading as snow), a checker running the strict rule on all eight judged pictures, and the open sounds.
phase 6: 1.15 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 1.15 h used of 12.00 h allowed
